memoryBuilder.verseText: Look! I can see Jesus standing up for me.

sequence.prompt: What happened to Stephen? Put it in order.

items.label: Stephen was chosen to help feed people
He told everyone the truth about Jesus
He looked up and heaven opened
He saw Jesus standing to welcome him

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: He stood to welcome Stephen home
Stephen was never alone for a second

application.question: Stephen looked at Jesus when things were hard. When is it hard for you to say you love Jesus?
application.followUp: Loving Jesus cost Stephen everything, and Jesus did not stay seated for it. Heaven opened, and the King of everything got up. Jesus stands for me.
